title: Explore MCP in Action
description: Connect Claude Desktop to a local MCP server and experience firsthand what AI can do with real tool access.
tools: A file system MCP server or GitHub MCP server
steps: Download and install Claude Desktop from claude.ai/download
Follow the Claude Desktop MCP setup guide to add the Filesystem MCP server
Allow Claude to access a non-sensitive folder on your computer
Ask Claude: "What files are in my documents folder?" and see it use the tool
Try a more complex task: "Read my notes file and summarize it"
expectedOutput: A working MCP connection and your own assessment of what this enables for future AI workflows.
bonusChallenges: Set up the GitHub MCP server and ask Claude to review your (or a public) repository
Document 3 real use cases where MCP would save you significant time
